**Interpreting food quantities**

I’m trying to make sense of what “eight” means in relation to food. Maybe it’s about servings or courses. For instance, “eight courses” or simply “eight servings.” The mention of octopus has me thinking about its eight arms, but that feels more like a stretch. I wonder if “eight glasses of water” might be another food-related interpretation. Then there’s the idea of “eight slices of pizza” or an “eight-piece chicken.” Let’s consider these options!
